entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,586 star（日均约 798，相对存量增速 4.4%），累计 126,412 star、8,015 fork。窗口内被 fork 406 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，468 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,586 stars over the last 7 days (~798/day, 4.4% of its base), now at 126,412 stars and 8,015 forks. 406 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 468 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一款 AI 编程协作平台，支持在桌面、移动端和云端同时运行多种编码代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）。开发者可以在同一界面里切换聊天或终端，管理多工作树，甚至把任务拆分给不同代理完成。
intro.en: Orca is an AI orchestration platform that lets you run multiple coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, and others—side‑by‑side on desktop, mobile, or cloud. Developers can switch between chat and terminal, manage isolated worktrees, and split big tasks across agents, all from a single app.

cardLine.zh: 一键管理多代理，支持桌面、移动和云端协作。
cardLine.en: One‑click orchestration of multiple agents across desktop, mobile, and cloud.

highlights.zh: 在聊天或终端中运行任何代理，保持上下文同步。
highlights.en: Run any agent in chat or raw CLI, preserving context across modes.

highlights.zh: 任务拆分：把大任务分配给子代理，自动收集结果。
highlights.en: Split large tasks into worker agents, automatically aggregating results.

highlights.zh: 支持远程服务器和云 VM，代理可在笔记本睡眠时继续运行。
highlights.en: Run agents on remote servers or cloud VMs, keeping them alive even when your laptop sleeps.

highlights.zh: 移动端可随时接收推送，回复聊天保持工作流不中断。
highlights.en: Mobile app receives agent notifications and lets you reply on the go, keeping the workflow flowing.

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,458 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,458 open issues — high relative to its star count

fitFor.zh: 探索多智能体协作、角色分工与复杂流水线编排的架构师
fitFor.en: Architects exploring multi-agent collaboration, role assignments, and pipeline orchestration

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)
# Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask.
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 3,972 star（日均约 567，相对存量增速 2.1%），累计 191,875 star、10,759 fork。窗口内被 fork 369 次，最近一次提交在 18 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 167 个、issue 200 个，132 位贡献者共同维护。

intro.zh: Ponytail 5 让 AI 代理像懒惰的资深开发者一样，只写必要代码，减少行数、时间和成本，同时保持安全性。它通过分析现有代码，自动合并或重构，生成更简洁、可测试的实现。
intro.en: Ponytail 5 teaches AI agents to write only what’s needed—like a lazy senior dev—cutting lines, time, and cost while preserving safety. It analyzes existing code, merges or refactors, and outputs concise, testable implementations.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI 只写必要代码，提升安全与效率。
cardLine.en: Make AI write only what’s necessary, boosting safety and efficiency.

highlights.zh: 在 Claude Code 中使用，任务完成率 98%，安全测试全通过。
highlights.en: In Claude Code, task completion rate is 98% and all security tests pass.

highlights.zh: 自动识别已有组件，减少代码量至 53% 行数。
highlights.en: Automatically reuses existing components, cutting code to 53% of original lines.

highlights.zh: 支持安全、错误处理、可访问性检查，保持代码完整性。
highlights.en: Includes checks for security, error handling, and accessibility to keep code robust.

highlights.zh: 提供完整审计模式，评估整个仓库并给出优先修复建议。
highlights.en: Offers a full audit mode that scans the repo and prioritizes fixes.

cardLine.zh: 将代码库映射为可查询的知识图谱，支持多平台。

highlights.en: Edges are tagged as EXTRACTED or INFERRED, so you know what was read directly.

highlights.zh: 支持查询、路径追踪和概念解释，替代传统 grep。

entries.name: firecrawl
entries.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,950 star（日均约 279，相对存量增速 1%），累计 202,232 star、10,601 fork。窗口内被 fork 79 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，171 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,950 stars over the last 7 days (~279/day, 1% of its base), now at 202,232 stars and 10,601 forks. 79 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 171 contributors.

intro.zh: Firecrawl 是一款专为 AI 代理打造的网页抓取与交互 API。它能快速、可靠地把网页内容转成 Markdown、JSON 或截图，直接供 LLM 使用。只需一行代码，你就能让你的 AI 代理像人类一样浏览、点击、滚动并提取信息。
intro.en: Firecrawl is a web scraping and interaction API built for AI agents. It quickly and reliably turns web pages into Markdown, JSON, or screenshots, ready for LLM consumption. With a single command, your AI agent can browse, click, scroll, and extract data just like a human.

cardLine.zh: 为 AI 代理提供极速、可靠的网页抓取与交互服务。
cardLine.en: Fast, reliable web scraping and interaction for AI agents.

highlights.zh: 支持 96% 的网页，包括 JS 重页面，零代理配置即可获取干净数据。
highlights.en: Covers 96% of the web, including JS-heavy pages, with no proxy setup needed.

highlights.zh: P95 延迟 3.4 秒，适合实时代理和动态应用。
highlights.en: P95 latency of 3.4s, ideal for real‑time agents and dynamic apps.

highlights.zh: 输出可直接用于 LLM：Markdown、结构化 JSON、截图等，节省 token。
highlights.en: LLM‑ready outputs—Markdown, structured JSON, screenshots—save token usage.

highlights.zh: 支持 PDF、DOCX 等文档转 Markdown/JSON，批量抓取、监控变更，一键集成。
highlights.en: Parse PDFs/DOCX to Markdown/JSON, batch scrape, monitor changes, all with one command.

cons.zh: 暂无独立文档系统（如 Wiki/Docs），查阅细节可能需通读 README
cons.en: No dedicated docs portal — onboarding relies primarily on README

cons.zh: 近 90 天未发布正式 Release 版本
cons.en: No formal releases in the last 90 days

fitFor.zh: 需要搭建知识库、文档问答或 RAG 检索链路的团队
fitFor.en: Teams building knowledge bases, doc Q&A, or RAG retrieval pipelines

fitFor.zh: 需要网页自动化操作、跨系统流程 RPA 或数据采集的工程师
fitFor.en: Engineers requiring web browser automation, cross-system RPA, or web data extraction

fitFor.zh: 要把 Agent 能力嵌进自己产品的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product

# 摘自 firecrawl/firecrawl 的 README
